name: Coding
description: Build or change software in small, verifiable increments: plan, decide, build, review.

fields.label: Goal
fields.hint: What should be true when this is done? Your own words are kept verbatim.

fields.label: Context and links
fields.hint: Issue, error output, related PRs, where in the code.

fields.label: Acceptance criteria
fields.hint: How we will know it works. The agent proposes these if left empty.

fields.label: Constraints and non-goals
fields.hint: What must not change; what is deliberately out of scope.

firstMove: Refine the Brief (ask about anything missing, propose acceptance criteria), then draft the Plan as small increments, and stop for the user to confirm before building.
